limitations: No real OBS operation or installed-app smoke; unpacked executable only.
No real App player/audio, private library, slow disk or large-library benchmark.
CPU is sum of Electron process percentCPUUsage, not host utilization. GPU process RAM is not VRAM; no GPU utilization or FPS measured.
Sequential baseline has process/cache order confounds; solo workload only two samples per state.
firstObservedMs includes initial load and reload, and is not cold first-frame timing; startup trace is authoritative.
Warmup exclusion does not establish a steady plateau. Cancelled soak has no final capture.
Tool snapshots differ between runs; source hashes and frozen runtime inputs retained per run. Packaged artifact is the recorded dirty-source snapshot, not a claim about later parallel edits.
Electron alpha pixels / automatic readable-text checks do not certify OBS compositing or artistic motion quality.
